claims.claim: The prospective roadmap selects only CAA-01, defines four sequential packages and conditional CAA-05 with exit/stop gates, and preserves prior TASK-407/408 records and bookmarks.

The provider-neutral read-only interface projects authenticated TASK revisions, RUN, terminal, evidence, correction, review and main-inclusion facts with applicable provenance bindings and explicit OBSERVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN separation.

The projection distinguishes completion-gate causes, ordered verification outcomes, malformed-summary availability and separate lifecycle stages; regression fixtures cover all four named failures and successful RESULT shapes.
Authenticated source cuts pin observed refs, historical TASK-only cuts exclude later lifecycle artifacts, and reconstruction rejects altered cuts, moved pins and rewritten main ancestry.
Positive and adversarial tests cover canonical identity, immutable revisions, repair supersession, repeat stability, missing/moved sources, cross-TASK bindings, redaction and injected source text.

Fixed ceilings bound selection, refs, document bytes, nesting, output, Git calls and elapsed time; unavailable facts remain UNKNOWN or produce bounded errors, with local object reads and explicit ref queries.

The committed change touches exactly the seven permitted paths and adds Brain Sync, Work Context and attention regressions while retaining existing production caller implementations and HUMAN_ON_DEMAND policy records.
The delivery establishes the CAA-01 data foundation and prospective conditional later packages, retains authority NONE, and preserves TASK-409's exact focused verification declaration for Runtime.
